entries.title: Show auto-update state on the Plugins screen
entries.detail: PR joyrmac/Scout-Plugins#88, held for Joy's OK. Cosmetic: the plugins already update themselves.

entries.title: Client logo beside the Scout mark on every Scout screen
entries.detail: Joy: on Features she could not tell whose site she was on. Logo from the theme's custom logo, else Site Icon. Sites update themselves. Sites with no logo or icon show the name only. PR joyrmac/Scout-Plugins#87.
entries.version: Admin kit 1.5.0, all 15 Scout plugins patched

entries.title: Email color picker on the Email screen
entries.detail: Maravela's test email came out in Scout blue. Email screen now has a color picker; detection also reads a block theme's accent/primary/brand color. PR joyrmac/Scout-Plugins#85.

entries.title: Spam blocked count on the Scout Dashboard
entries.detail: Forms Guard counts blocked spam by month; the Scout Dashboard box shows this month and the last year. Counts start at 0 on update. PR joyrmac/Scout-Plugins#84. Sites with auto-updates off (Maravela's, Patrick) need it by hand.

entries.title: Turn on auto-updates for the Scout plugins
entries.detail: Scout plugins updated themselves to current (Build 0.6.2 by 12:18). They install their own updates once WordPress sees a release; no toggle needed.

entries.title: Scout Build 0.6.1: branded test email; fix ' in Copy for Claude
